import json

entries = data.get("entries", [])

# Build a tree-like structure grouped by directory
from collections import defaultdict

dirs = defaultdict(list)
for e in entries:
    path = e["path"].replace("/workspace/", "")
    parts = path.rsplit("/", 1)
    folder = parts[0] if len(parts) > 1 else "."
    name = parts[-1]
    size = e.get("size_bytes", 0)
    is_dir = e.get("is_dir", False)
    dirs[folder].append((name, size, is_dir))

# Print organized listing
print(f"Total entries: {len(entries)}\n")
for folder in sorted(dirs.keys()):
    print(f"📁 {folder}/")
    for name, size, is_dir in sorted(dirs[folder]):
        icon = "📁" if is_dir else "📄"
        size_str = f"{size:,} bytes" if not is_dir else ""
        print(f"   {icon} {name}  {size_str}")
    print()
